source: The index selection itself is discrete. Within a region where the selected set does not change, however, selected gate values are differentiable functions of the router scores. Shazeer et al. explicitly note nonzero derivatives for selected experts whenZXMATH0000XZ and Switch notes that its gate value supplies a differentiable path even with Top-1 routing. Auxiliary router losses can provide additional gradient signals.
zh: 索引选择本身是离散的。然而，在所选集合不改变的区域内，所选门值是路由器分数的可微函数。沙泽尔等人。当 ZXMATH0000XZ 和 Switch 指出其门值即使使用 Top-1 路由也提供可微分路径时，明确记录所选专家的非零导数。辅助路由器损耗可以提供额外的梯度信号。
